concerns.text: Task T008 (Power‑analysis script) is scheduled in Phase 0 before any data ingestion or merging tasks, yet it requires the species‑overlap count *after merging* RSA and TRY data. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency; the merged dataset is only produced later in Task T021. Move T008 to run after T021 (or after the merge step) to satisfy the producer‑before‑consumer ordering rule.
